title: Allgemeinverfügungen erlassen – Einschränkungen im Bezirk Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf

extraction.summaryEn: Police issued a temporary general order banning carrying weapons and knives on 19 April 2026 from 7:00 to 16:30 around the Olympiastadion for the S25 running event. The restriction covers a defined area in Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf.
